## Author Checklist

- [ ] My branch is up to date with `main` and CI is green.
- [ ] My commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) and are **signed-off** (`-s`).
- [ ] I have added or updated **tests** (or stated why none are needed).
- [ ] I have added or updated **documentation** (`README.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/`, code docstrings).
- [ ] I have updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `## [Unreleased]` if user-visible behaviour changed.
- [ ] I have run `make check` locally and it passes.
- [ ] I considered backwards compatibility (see [`VERSIONING.md`](../VERSIONING.md)).
- [ ] I considered security and privacy implications (see [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md)).
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or proprietary data are included.
